research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Synvivia is researching methods and compositions for the production of recombinant viral vectors in host cells using engineered cyclic peptides, as described in 'Engineered cyclic peptides for enhancing viral production.' The approach focuses on increasing viral titer and transduction efficiency by employing engineered peptides, aligning with Synvivia’s focus on creating organisms that can be controlled with small molecules. This highlights their work in controllable biological systems and molecular modulation.

product_launches.description: World Precision Instruments and SynVivo launched the SynTEER-on-a-Chip system, a platform for multiplexed TEER measurement in organ-on-a-chip models, initially validated on the SynBBB Blood-Brain Barrier model.

overview_description.description: Synvivia makes ON-OFF switches for genetically engineered organisms. These protein switches are controlled by small molecules. By installing these switches into an organism, Synvivia creates engineered organisms that can be controlled with small molecules.
